units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14">Cant. R. to I, 14</cite> (play on <he>בכרמי</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14">ib.</cite>) <he>זה יעקב … בכ׳ פניו וכ׳</he> that alludes to Jacob who went in to his father with paleness of face, trembling in his shame &c.

senses.gloss: K’rum, name of a bird changing colors in the sun.
